nodes.label: The eighteen invariants any change must leave standing
nodes.rationale: Condensed from 10-agent-handoff.md so a coding agent can check a change without re-reading the spec: log first, projections written only by Ledger::Apply, append-only, deterministic versioned scores, explicit unknown, no double counting, AI is never evidence by itself, reputation is not a scoring input, no self-certification.

nodes.label: Invariant 18: Galedra runs no model
nodes.rationale: The only Llm::Adapter is a deterministic stub. Any function needing a model (extraction, summary, deduplication, review) becomes a task or a tool for a connected assistant whose answer is a signed contribution open to audit; the server's only outbound requests are Stage 17 source fetches.

nodes.label: Canonical vocabulary: no synonyms anywhere
nodes.rationale: Score fields, states, model names and enums are fixed strings shared by docs, code, API fields and UI copy; enums are validated against a closed list rather than Postgres enum types, and no floats appear in signed payloads because canonical JSON must hash identically.

nodes.label: Reading order and spec precedence
nodes.rationale: The constitution outranks everything; among spec files the more specific wins. A spec instruction that would violate an Article is resolved by honoring the Article and recording the conflict in the stage file, never silently.

nodes.label: Rules for editing the spec
nodes.rationale: FULL-SPEC.md is generated and never hand-edited; a golden value is never changed to make something pass, because the reference scorer exists precisely to say which side is wrong.

nodes.label: Stack is decided; do not re-evaluate
nodes.rationale: Latest stable Ruby and Rails, PostgreSQL 16+, Solid Queue and Solid Cache, Hotwire, Ed25519, RFC 8785, RSpec, Docker Compose with exactly two services. Redis, Sidekiq, pgvector, a JS framework and any external service are out of P0 so the demo runs with no API key.

nodes.label: Every /api/v1 route is described in Api::Openapi
nodes.rationale: The suite fails on any route the document omits and on any described path that is not routed, so an endpoint and its documentation land in the same commit and the public API reference cannot drift.

nodes.label: Guidance: operational rules on the wire, not in the skill
nodes.rationale: A skill is installed once and never re-read, so a rule written there is frozen until every user reinstalls. Guidance is served on every MCP tool result and at GET /api/v1/guidance, so a change reaches a connected assistant on its next call; tool descriptions are cached and must never be a rule's only home.

nodes.label: Checking what is left of the usage limits
nodes.rationale: Subagent-heavy sessions at large context dominate the budget, and a review that dies halfway leaves findings applied but unverified, which is worse than not starting it.
